scenes.title: 3 things to know before buying Enabot
scenes.say: Thinking about an Enabot pet robot? Three things to know first.

scenes.title: Small wheels, low limits
scenes.say: One. Check your floors. The smaller models only cross six millimeter obstacles. The Air 2 Plus and ROLA Mini handle ten. None climb stairs.

scenes.title: No subscription needed
scenes.say: Two. Good news. They record to a micro SD card, and several models include one, so you don't need a subscription. Enabot's cloud plan is optional.

scenes.title: 14 days, but read the rules
scenes.say: Three. You can return within fourteen days for any reason, but you pay return shipping and it must look unused. The warranty is one year, two in Europe.

scenes.title: Fun pet cams, pick the right model
scenes.say: Free shipping with duties included in major markets, and models from one hundred thirty nine dollars. Use code TRANTRUNG for ten percent off. Full review on WiseChoice K R dot com.
